WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as sum_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.A3,
    s1.count,
    CAST(s1.count AS REAL) / s2.sum_count as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.A3,
    s3.count,
    s3.ratio,
    s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_of_ratios,
  AVG(diff) as avg_of_differences
FROM step5
